name: AkuAuction refund-counter mismatch permanently locks project funds
summary: claimProjectFunds() required refundProgress to reach totalBids, but processRefunds() advanced refundProgress once per bidder entry while totalBids counted auction units. After the refund sweep processed all 3,668 bidder entries, refundProgress equalled bidIndex at 3,669 while totalBids remained 5,495, making the project withdrawal condition permanently unsatisfiable and locking the residual auction balance.

loss.notes: The selected final refund batch exhausted every bidder entry and left exactly 11,539.5 ETH in AkuAuction (5,495 auction units at the 2.1 ETH closing Dutch price), equal to its balance at review time to the wei. Bidder refunds that succeeded are not loss, and the temporary refund-griefing episode caused no permanent loss and is context only. The valuation uses the last DefiLlama ETH observation before that transaction.

ageReset.description: This transaction directly deployed the immutable AkuAuction runtime containing processRefunds() and the unreachable claimProjectFunds() condition.

sources.note: Reviewed every processRefunds() transaction through the selected final batch, contract state, verified source, the commit-pinned reproduction, the deployment transaction, and archive-node runtimes. AkuAuction 0xf42c318dbfbaab0eee040279c6a2588fa01a961d was directly deployed at block 14636831:436 by owner 0xcc0ecd808ce4fed81f0552b3889656b28aa2bae9. Its 6,525-byte runtime hashes to 0x798c8681b76572d14dfa041d337a8e065029a47c1ff1fe358a23c7efe1ba5384 at deployment and immediately before the selected transaction. The selected processRefunds() call exhausted all 3,669 bidder entries, leaving bidIndex and refundProgress at 3,669 while totalBids remained 5,495. An eth_call from the owner to claimProjectFunds() at that state reverts with Refunds not yet processed. The contract balance then and at review time is exactly 11,539.5 ETH. This final state transition is the onchain failure boundary for the permanent lock.

Independently re-verified every claim against the Etherscan-verified AkuAuction source (v0.8.13), an Ethereum archive node, Etherscan's full transaction list for the contract, transaction replays, and DefiLlama. Defect: bid() accumulates totalBids in auction units (final value 5,495) but creates one allBids entry per unique bidder, advancing bidIndex once per bidder (final value 3,669, entries 1..3,668, both counters initialized to 1); processRefunds() advances refundProgress once per entry and requires refundProgress < bidIndex; claimProjectFunds() requires refundProgress >= totalBids. refundProgress is therefore capped at 3,669 < 5,495 forever. Anchor: the eleventh and final successful processRefunds() (selector 0xa8feda51) at block 14638073 index 40, timestamp 1650675891, from 0xd2dea18d040152c580f29195b29670633b0c9796, gas used 4,819,236; the eleven successful batches advanced refundProgress 1 -> 293 -> 585 -> 877 -> 1173 -> 1486 -> 1787 -> 2175 -> 2585 -> 2900 -> 3191 -> 3669, and the anchor dropped the balance from 11,552.6 to exactly 11,539,500,000,000,000,000,000 wei (5,495 units x the 2.1 ETH closing Dutch price), byte-equal to the balance at review time. Finality: before the anchor the residual was not yet irrecoverable, because any entry with finalProcess == 0 could withdraw its full price x bidsPlaced through emergencyWithdraw() after expiresAt + 3 days (1,650,924,061); the anchor batch set finalProcess = 1 on every remaining entry (entries 1, 2, 100, 2000 and 3668 all read finalProcess 1), after which emergencyWithdraw() reverts for every bidder, processRefunds() reverts with Refunds already processed (reproduced now), an owner eth_call to claimProjectFunds() reverts with Refunds not yet processed (reproduced now), bidding is expired (expiresAt 1650664861), receive() reverts, the remaining owner functions (loadMintPassOwners, setNFTContract, transferOwnership, renounceOwnership) only write storage, and the disassembled 6,525-byte runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT with EIP-1967 implementation, admin and beacon slots zero. All 56 later external transactions to the contract failed, including the owner's two attempts at block 14638084. Griefing scoping: the six processRefunds() failures before the first successful batch (blocks 14637263-14637816) replay as OutOfGas at 100k-1M gas limits rather than a bidder revert, and the first successful 5.07M-gas batch refunded entries 1-292 with no subcall consuming gas, so the publicly reported refund-blocking contract had already released before the refund sweep; every bidder entry was processed, the griefing caused no theft and no permanent loss, and it is context rather than a second incident. Identity and age: the deployment transaction at block 14636831 index 436, timestamp 1650659547, was sent by owner 0xcc0ecd808ce4fed81f0552b3889656b28aa2bae9 with contractAddress 0xf42c318dbfbaab0eee040279c6a2588fa01a961d; no code exists at the address in block 14636830, and the runtime hashes to 0x798c8681b76572d14dfa041d337a8e065029a47c1ff1fe358a23c7efe1ba5384 at deployment, at block 14638072 immediately before the anchor, and at review time, making deployment the only executable-code event and the age 1650675891 - 1650659547 = 16,344 seconds. Loss: 11,539.5 ETH permanently locked, valued at DefiLlama's last pre-anchor observation, 2,958.956157302791 USD/ETH at 1650675626 (265 seconds before the anchor), giving 34,144,874.577195555 USD; successful bidder refunds are not loss. Note one correction to the earlier attestation's wording: the sweep processed 3,668 bidder entries; bidIndex and refundProgress end at 3,669 because both start at 1.

notes: The seed record used the first successful refund batch. This record uses the final batch that exhausts every bidder entry and establishes the irrecoverable counter mismatch onchain: only after it does emergencyWithdraw() stop being an escape hatch for the remaining balance, so it is the transaction that makes the permanent loss final.
